scope: archives 505, 538, 547, 594 and 725: the raft virus, Regal at ANSA after the transmitter falls silent, Duo steering the rocket, the grandpas quarrelling over advice, and the Footbomb players after Netto beats them
provenance: Claude, 2026-09-27; wording decided against translations/story_source.jsonl and the terminology adopted in earlier batches, with 19 lines seeded from decisions those batches already made
